name: B10-0229/2026 (PfE) – Shortcomings and deficiencies of the ‘Amnesty Law’ in Venezuela
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on shortcomings and deficiencies of the ‘Amnesty Law’ in Venezuela
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion on Venezuela's Amnesty Law. It says the law is applied unfairly by courts loyal to the government, and that many political prisoners are still held. It calls on Venezuela to release all remaining political prisoners, restore political rights, lift the ban on opposition figure María Corina Machado, and let Venezuelans abroad return safely.

- No law changes; Parliament asks Venezuela to release all political prisoners and restore political rights.
- Affects prisoners, opposition figures like María Corina Machado, and Venezuelans living abroad.
- Next, European Union countries are urged to press Venezuela diplomatically for a peaceful transition.
